completeAuditFixture.usage: Import once for a complete NuvioTV or NuvioMobile audit; component fixtures are targeted reruns only, and Mobile requires the combined fixture whenever compareTo crosses components.

clientImportBehavior.nuvioTv: Imports and upserts collections by collection ID, so the four audit collections can coexist.
clientImportBehavior.nuvioMobile: Replaces the current collection list with the newly imported list, so a complete audit requires the combined fixture.

sources.title: M1 Movie baseline
sources.expectedStaticBehavior: Unfiltered Movie DISCOVER baseline using popularity.desc.

sources.title: M2 Movie withGenres 28
sources.expectedStaticBehavior: Both clients deserialize and forward with_genres=28; visible effect needs device evidence.

sources.title: T1 TV baseline
sources.expectedStaticBehavior: Unfiltered TV DISCOVER baseline using popularity.desc.

sources.title: T2 TV withNetworks 49

sources.title: D1 Movie withNetworks 49 divergence
